title: Recall: Measure and combine UTF-8 text
summary: Reconstruct complete expressions using the specified reference form. Formatting may vary; alternative implementations belong in Apply. Each clue states its own context because surrounding code is hidden in Recall.

append.clue: Given mutable text: String and suffix: String, write a complete statement appending suffix to text using push_str and an explicit as_str call. Include the semicolon.

format.clue: Given text: String, write a format macro expression producing owned text with the current text enclosed in square brackets. Use named capture {text}, without a separate format argument.
